summary: A Quote subscription streams Vortex ohlcv: the 62-byte packet gives the price, trade time, OHLC and volume, and no last quantity, average price or book totals; a packet with no trade time is stamped on receipt.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; the Rupeezy web adapter sends no data.mode.

The Rupeezy web adapter adds the broker's instrument token as a string to every frame; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it. Whether the desktop carries it is the lead's decision (a broker identifier, not a market field).
The Rupeezy web adapter repeats ltp as last_price in every frame; the desktop sends no such alias yet.
The Rupeezy web adapter repeats the previous close as prev_close wherever the packet carries a close; the desktop sends no such alias yet.
The web sends the change against the previous close in every frame of a packet that carries a close (ohlcv, full); the desktop sends it in index Quote and Depth frames only.
deviations.ref: rupeezy_adapter.py:225-231; audit C04 (change on all exchanges)

deviations.reason: An ltp packet, or an ohlcv packet with no trade time, carries no trade time; the web sends ltt null, the desktop sends the receipt time as the trade time (the bridge's fallback), which the lead's rules forbid. A desktop defect: mark the trade time absent for such packets, so ltt is left out (the desktop's form of null).
deviations.ref: rupeezy_adapter.py:222 (ltt None without a trade time); feed::bridge::ltt; BKD-03

deviations.reason: Without a trade time or update time the web sends timestamp null, a market data frame with no time (the SDK reads data.timestamp); the desktop stamps the time the packet was received.
deviations.ref: rupeezy_adapter.py:223 ((last_update_time or ltt or 0) * 1000 or None)

deviations.reason: Vortex's ohlcv packet carries no last quantity, average price or book totals, so the web's Quote frame has none; the desktop sends them as 0, which CLAUDE.md's absent-field rule forbids (web openalgo#2376): a desktop defect, fixed by marking them absent for an ohlcv packet.
deviations.ref: rupeezy/streaming.rs::packet_events (sets them from a packet without them); rupeezy_websocket.py:70-83; BKD-02
